IMAGE_COMPRESSION.TITLE: Image Compression
IMAGE_COMPRESSION.DESCRIPTION: PNG compression is lossless, so it might not reduce the file size significantly and higher compression values might affect the performance. JPG and WebP compression is lossy.

CUSTOM_MODELS.TITLE: ADD CUSTOM MODELS
CUSTOM_MODELS.DESCRIPTION: You can add your own models easily. For more details:

CUSTOM_INPUT_RESOLUTION.TITLE: CUSTOM OUTPUT WIDTH
CUSTOM_INPUT_RESOLUTION.DESCRIPTION: Use a custom width for the output images. The height will be adjusted automatically. Enabling this will override the scale setting.

GPU_ID_INPUT.TITLE: GPU ID
GPU_ID_INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Please read the Rescayl Documentation for more information.
GPU_ID_INPUT.ADDITIONAL_DESCRIPTION: Enable performance mode on Windows for better results.

COPY_METADATA.TITLE: COPY IMAGE METADATA
COPY_METADATA.DESCRIPTION: Keep original image metadata (EXIF) in the upscaled image.
COPY_METADATA.SUGGEST_JPG_DESCRIPTION: For better metadata compatibility across different systems, we recommend using JPG format. Would you like to change?

IMAGE_SCALE.TITLE: Image Scale
IMAGE_SCALE.DESCRIPTION: Anything above 4X (except 16X Double Rescayl) only resizes the image and does not use AI upscaling.
IMAGE_SCALE.WARNING: Anything above 5X may cause performance issues on some devices!
IMAGE_SCALE.ADDITIONAL_WARNING: This may cause performance issues on some devices!

OVERWRITE_TOGGLE.TITLE: OVERWRITE PREVIOUS UPSCALE
OVERWRITE_TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, Rescayl will process the image again instead of loading it directly.

RESET_SETTINGS.ALERT: Rescayl has been reset. Please restart the app.

SAVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER.TITLE: SAVE OUTPUT FOLDER
SAVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, the output folder will be remembered between sessions.

AUTO_UPDATE.TITLE: AUTO UPDATE UPSCAYL
AUTO_UPDATE.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, the application will check for new updates and notify you.

ENABLE_CONTRIBUTION.TITLE: HELP IMPROVE UPSCAYL
ENABLE_CONTRIBUTION.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, Rescayl will collect anonymous usage data to improve the application interface and features.

CUSTOM_TILE_SIZE.TITLE: CUSTOM TILE SIZE
CUSTOM_TILE_SIZE.DESCRIPTION: Use a custom tile size for segmenting the image. This can help process images faster by reducing the number of tiles generated.

TURN_OFF_NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: TURN OFF NOTIFICATIONS
TURN_OFF_NOTIFICATIONS.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, Rescayl will not send any system notifications on success or failure.

TTA_MODE.TITLE: TTA Mode
TTA_MODE.DESCRIPTION: Enable Test Time Augmentation for better results, such as removing artifacts BUT this will increase the processing time by 8x!

PRESERVE_FILENAME.TITLE: PRESERVE ORIGINAL FILENAME
PRESERVE_FILENAME.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, the upscaled image keeps the original filename instead of appending the scale and model.

BATCH_MODE.TITLE: Batch Rescayl
BATCH_MODE.DESCRIPTION: This will let you Rescayl all files in a folder at once

upscayl-standard-4x.NAME: Rescayl Standard
upscayl-standard-4x.DESCRIPTION: General purpose 4x upscaling (32 MB). Best for photos and natural images. Balanced quality and speed. 4 GB+ VRAM recommended.

upscayl-lite-4x.NAME: Rescayl Lite
upscayl-lite-4x.DESCRIPTION: Lightweight 4x upscaling (2.4 MB). Fastest model — ideal for quick previews or low-end GPUs. Works well on integrated GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM.

remacri-4x.NAME: Remacri (Non-Commercial)
remacri-4x.DESCRIPTION: 4x photo upscaler (32 MB) with enhanced sharpness and fine detail. Great for nature and portrait photography. 4 GB+ VRAM recommended. Non-commercial use only.

ultramix-balanced-4x.NAME: Ultramix (Non-Commercial)
ultramix-balanced-4x.DESCRIPTION: 4x model (32 MB) balancing sharpness and natural detail. Ideal for mixed photo content where neither extreme sharpness nor heavy smoothing is desired. 4 GB+ VRAM recommended. Non-commercial use only.

ultrasharp-4x.NAME: Ultrasharp (Non-Commercial)
ultrasharp-4x.DESCRIPTION: 4x model (32 MB) tuned for maximum sharpness and edge detail. Best for images where crisp detail matters most. 4 GB+ VRAM recommended. Non-commercial use only.

digital-art-4x.NAME: Digital Art
digital-art-4x.DESCRIPTION: 4x upscaler (8.6 MB) designed for digital art, illustrations, and painted images. Preserves clean lines and flat colors. 2 GB+ VRAM recommended.

realesr-animevideov3-x2.NAME: Anime Video (2x)
realesr-animevideov3-x2.DESCRIPTION: Fast 2x upscaler (1.2 MB) for anime, cartoons, and stylized video frames. Extremely lightweight — runs well on integrated GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM.

realesr-animevideov3-x3.NAME: Anime Video (3x)
realesr-animevideov3-x3.DESCRIPTION: Fast 3x upscaler (1.2 MB) for anime, cartoons, and stylized video frames. Extremely lightweight — runs well on integrated GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM.

realesr-animevideov3-x4.NAME: Anime Video (4x)
realesr-animevideov3-x4.DESCRIPTION: Fast 4x upscaler (1.2 MB) for anime, cartoons, and stylized video frames. Extremely lightweight — runs well on integrated GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM.

high-fidelity-4x.NAME: High Fidelity
high-fidelity-4x.DESCRIPTION: 4x model (32 MB) focused on realistic detail preservation and smooth textures. Best all-around choice for photos, mixed content, and general use. 4 GB+ VRAM recommended.

BG_REMOVAL.TITLE: BG Removal
BG_REMOVAL.DESCRIPTION: Automatically remove the background from your images before or after upscaling.
BG_REMOVAL.REQUIRES_PYTHON: Uses an AI segmentation model bundled with Rescayl. No additional setup required.

isnet-general-use.NAME: ISNet General
isnet-general-use.DESCRIPTION: High quality AI segmentation for general subjects, especially people. Bundled with Rescayl.

DOUBLE_UPSCAYL.TITLE: Double Rescayl
DOUBLE_UPSCAYL.DESCRIPTION: Enable this option to run upscayl twice on an image. Note that this may cause a significant increase in processing time and possibly performance issues for scales greater than 4X.

OUTPUT_PATH_SELECTION.MAC_APP_STORE_ALERT:
Due to MacOS App Store security restrictions, Rescayl requires you to select an output folder everytime you start it.

To avoid this, you can permanently save a default output folder in the Rescayl 'Settings' tab.

EXCEPTION_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Rescayl encountered an error. Possibly, the upscayl binary failed to execute the commands properly. Try checking the logs to see if you get any information.

NO_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ERROR.TITLE: Set Output Folder
NO_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Please select an output folder first
